recognize_zh: MPO 細胞化學染色下，左下方一顆芽細胞的淡紫色細胞質中，有幾條細長針狀、染成紅棕色的桿狀物，就是 Auer rod；右下另有一顆整個細胞質呈棕色顆粒陽性的細胞。Auer rod 呈 MPO 陽性，證明芽細胞屬骨髓系，支持 AML。
features: Population of large blasts with high N:C ratio and pale lightly counterstained nuclei
One blast containing several thin, needle-shaped cytoplasmic Auer rods staining red-brown with MPO
Adjacent cell with diffuse coarse brown granular MPO positivity
Many surrounding blasts show weak to negligible MPO reaction (heterogeneous positivity)
Red cells in the background are unstained
describe_en: Peripheral blood or marrow smear stained cytochemically for myeloperoxidase with a light counterstain shows numerous large blasts. One blast contains several slender, needle-like cytoplasmic inclusions that are MPO positive, representing Auer rods, and a neighboring cell shows strong diffuse granular MPO positivity; many other blasts are weakly reactive or negative. MPO-positive Auer rods establish myeloid lineage. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are MPO negative (<3%) and never contain Auer rods.
APL shows intensely MPO-positive hypergranular cells with bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) in most abnormal promyelocytes, not scattered single rods in otherwise weakly reactive blasts.
Monoblasts are usually MPO negative or weak and NSE positive, and Auer rods are rare.
Precipitate lies on top of or outside cells in multiple planes, whereas Auer rods are intracytoplasmic, uniform in shape and MPO reactive.
